item.title: Spiritual Leadership in the Home: A Biblical Vision
item.description: In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins offers a clear, biblical vision for spiritual leadership within the Christian home—neither passive nor authoritarian, but Christlike, humble, and faithful. item.title: Testing the Spirits: Why Contemplative Spirituality Is an Unbiblical Path to Spiritual Growth
item.description: In this Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins and Marcia Montenegro examine contemplative spirituality and why Christians must test the spirits by Scripture.

item.title: Forgiveness and Humility in Marriage: A Biblical Answer
item.description: Marriage is one of God’s greatest gifts and one of His most refining means of grace. In this Contending for the Word Q&A episode, Dave Jenkins explains how couples can practice forgiveness and humility in marriage through the gospel, confession, grace, and repentance, anchored in Colossians 3:12–13.

item.title: Trusting Jesus With the Future: The Hope of the Alpha and Omega
item.description: In this episode of New Age to Christ, Doreen Virtue encourages believers to confront fear and anxiety about the future by fixing their eyes on Jesus Christ—the Alpha and the Omega. Drawing from Revelation 1:8, this devotional points listeners to the sovereignty of Christ and the hope believers have in Him.

item.title: Psalm 3: God Our Shield When Trouble Surrounds Us
item.description: Dave Jenkins walks through Psalm 3 and explains how God is our shield, sustainer, and deliverer when trouble surrounds us. A daily Bible reading and devotional from Reading the Bible Daily with Dave.

item.title: Marriage Is a Covenant: Displaying the Gospel in the Home
item.description: Dave Jenkins explains why marriage is a covenant designed by God to display the gospel and how biblical marriage is shaped by Christ-centered love, repentance, and faithfulness.
